items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 23 at 4:04PM PST until November 25 at 8:00AM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor to moderate
coastal flooding. For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking
waves of 5 to 8 feet with dangerous rip currents. For the
Coastal Flood Warning, significant coastal flooding expected.
For the High Surf Warning, large damaging breaking waves of 8
to 15 feet with dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...Ventura County Beaches.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 8 AM PST
Wednesday. For the High Surf Advisory, from 9 PM Tuesday to 8
AM PST Wednesday. For the Coastal Flood Warning, from 8 AM
Wednesday to noon PST Thursday. For the High Surf Warning,
from 8 AM Wednesday to noon PST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Damaging flooding of sea water is likely over some
vulnerable low-lying coastal areas, especially around the time
of high tide, including over beaches (especially from Faria
Beach to Silver Strand Beach), roads, and structures.
Significant beach erosion is expected. Powerful waves and
strong rip currents will pose an exceptional risk of ocean
drowning and damage to coastal structures like piers
(including Ventura Pier) and jetties. Large breaking waves can
cause injury, wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize
small boats near shore. Large breaking waves may impact
Ventura and Channel Islands Harbors. Extremely high tides may
cause dock damage and seawater spillage over low lying areas
inside of harbor areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Extremely high tides of 8.1-8.5 feet will
likely peak between 7am and 11am. Coastal Flood and High Surf
Advisories are likely to follow the expiration of the
respective warnings.
items.instruction:
Stay off of beaches and coastal walkways, roads, and structures.
Do NOT drive around barricades or through water of unknown depth.

Everyone should remain out of the water due to life-threatening
surf conditions. Stay off of jetties, piers, and other water side
infrastructure.
